items.text: AJ Brown QUESTIONABLE (ankle); unclear status. Rapoport: practiced limited all week earlier than expected. Levitan: unclear on Q tag.
items.why: Ankle; limited all week but Q
items.implication: Game-time; monitor for Patriots WR1 role if active
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to other NE WRs/RBs; if IN, full role

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers (hamstring). Schefter confirmed Eagles official ruling; first confirmation of absence alongside Hurts.
items.why: Hamstring; did not practice; official Friday ruling
items.implication: Major RB downgrade for PHI; handcuff/backup volume spike
items.opportunity: Goal-line and early-down work to Dameon Pierce (4th-string noted by Levitan) and remaining backs

items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT for Week 6 (calf/blood clot); Eagles' first game without him. Tanner McKee starts. Rapoport: first game without Hurts.
items.implication: McKee start; pass-catcher volume may hold or shift with healthy top targets
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for healthy PHI pass-catchers; RB thinner

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT again for Week 6 (ankle). Rapoport confirms Ravens another game without him; Huntley starts.
items.implication: Continued backup QB; Flowers still viable but overall offense downgraded

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition as QUESTIONABLE. Schefter confirmed Friday add after drills injury. Levitan flags as new Q.
items.why: Groin suffered in Friday individual drills

items.text: Tanner McKee starts for PHI with 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce but top-4 pass-catchers healthy: DeVonta, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon. Despite thin RB.
items.why: Hurts/Barkley OUT but healthy skill WRs/TE
items.implication: Pass-catchers maintain or gain opportunity under McKee
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to healthy top-4; limited RB support

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 6 along with AD Mitchell. Jets backfield thinned.
items.implication: Increased work for remaining Jets RBs

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin); did not travel for London game per reports.
items.implication: HOC RB volume to remaining backs (Marks etc.)

items.text: Ladd McConkey IN / no designation (cleared). Schefter: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation.
items.implication: Full WR role expected vs KC

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN (cleared from prior). Healthy top pass-catchers for McKee.
items.implication: WR1 role with McKee; top-4 pass catchers healthy per Levitan
items.opportunity: Full route share despite Hurts/Barkley OUT

items.text: PIT without WRs Michael Pittman, Roman Wilson, Ben Skowronek. Expecting lots of 2-WR sets with DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard. Metcalf illness Q but probable-like.
items.implication: Metcalf (if plays) higher target/snap share in 2-WR
items.conflict: Metcalf Q illness but Levitan views as probable

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Mike Evans as WR4 vs WSH. Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers; strong usage case.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH pass defense; volume
items.implication: Start with confidence as top WR play
items.opportunity: High target share in favorable spot

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London as WR6 vs CHI. Bankable usage in soft matchup.
Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle as WR28 vs SEA. Ugly matchup and QB concerns.
items.why: Tough SEA pass defense + shaky QB situation
